definitions.explanation: A teacher who works at a juku (cram school), typically helping students prepare for exams.

examples.japanese: {塾講師|じゅくこうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I work part-time as a cram school teacher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学生|だいがくせい}→大学生：01653_daigakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき、{塾講師|じゅくこうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a university student, I worked as a cram school teacher.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{塾講師|じゅくこうし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{教|おし}え{方|かた}→教え方：28588_oshiekata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまい→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: That cram school teacher is popular because they're good at teaching.

notes:
{塾講師|じゅくこうし} is a compound of ⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧ (cram school) and ⟦{講師|こうし}→講師：00451_koushi⟧ (instructor). Refers to anyone who teaches at a juku, whether full-time professional or part-time student worker.

CULTURAL NOTE:
⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧ are private supplementary schools where students study after regular school hours, often to prepare for entrance exams. Working as a {塾講師|じゅくこうし} is one of the most common part-time jobs for university students in Japan.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {塾講師|じゅくこうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧: part-time juku teaching job
- {塾講師|じゅくこうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to recruit juku teachers

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{予備校|よびこう}→予備校：04785_yobikou⟧⟦{講師|こうし}→講師：00451_koushi⟧: prep school instructor (for university entrance)
